entries.en: Smells like smoke and death.
Eden Prime will never be the same again.
Check your targets. Could be friendlies.
We should move, Commander
We thought this world was safe... until the geth showed up.
It used to be beautiful here.
Somebody's going to pay for this.
Let's get the bastards.
We should move.
Oh god. What happened here?
Huh.
Hmm.
Look at that.
Strange.
Uh-huh.
Oh.
That man was still alive when they stuck him on the spike.
Killing us isn't enough. The geth want us to suffer.
Impaling victims instead of just shooting them... there must be some reason behind  it.
Classic psychological warfare. They're using terror as a weapon.
Now we know what those spikes are for: turning our own dead against us.
It must take a few hours for the spikes to turn people into husks.
Gas bags. Don't worry - they're harmless.
What the hell are those?
Freaky looking things, aren't they?
Oh, god. What happened here?
This place got hit hard, Commander. Hostiles everywhere. Keep your guard up.
Ship perimeter secure, Commander!
No sign of Nihlus. Damn, he's fast.
Damn!
Oh, yeah. Don't stand next to them when the shooting starts.
Maybe we should check on Jenkins.
Argh!
Jenkins. Take point.
Move up.
Sometimes marines die. The rest of just have to carry on. We still have to find that beacon.
We can't help him now.
Ripped right through his shields. Never had a chance.
We'll see that he receives a proper service once the mission is complete. But I need you to stay focused.
Leave him. We need to finish the mission.
He deserves a burial.
I've got some burned out buildings here, Shepard. A lot of bodies.
I'm going to check it out. I'll try to catch up with you at the dig site.
Thanks for your help, Commander. I didn't think I was going to make it.
Gunnery Chief Ashley Williams of the 212. You the one in charge here, sir?
A few scrapes and burns. Nothing serious. The others weren't so lucky.
Oh, man.... We were patrolling the perimeter when the attack hit.
We tried to double back to the beacon. But we walked into an ambush.
I don't think any of the others.... I think I'm the only one left.
Yes, sir. We held our position as long as we could. Until the geth overwhelmed us.
I think they're geth.
We held our position as long as we could. The geth overwhelmed us!
The dig site is close. Just over that rise. It might still be there.
Aye, aye, sir. It's time for payback.
Let me come with you, sir. The geth slaughtered my unit. Give me a chance to get even!
She knows the area, Commander. And we could use the extra firepower.
Understood, Commander. You give the orders and I'll follow 'em.
They were doing some digging out here to extend the monorail and expand the colony. A few weeks ago they unearthed some Prothean ruins... and the beacon.
I don't know much about the beacon itself. But I heard one of the researchers say this could be the biggest scientific discovery of the century.
We were sent out a couple nights ago from the main colony to secure the area.
